svg.text: Harvard organisation, hardwired Control Unit with an internal control-word pipeline (cw → cw1 → cw2 → cw3).
Branches and jumps are resolved in DECODE, so a mispredict costs a single flushed instruction.
mispredict · recovery address · BTB update (ID → IF)
cw → cw1 → cw2 → cw3 · stall / flush arbiter
MUXA_SEL · MUXB_SEL · ALU_OPCODE · DRAM_WE · WB_MUX_SEL · RF_WE
Resolving branches in DECODE instead of EXECUTE is what makes the 1-cycle mispredict penalty possible: the wrong-path instruction is still in IF/ID and is simply cleared.
The price is a new hazard class — a branch whose operand is still in flight — absorbed by branch_stall_alarm plus the dedicated ID forwarding path.
